short: Disguises its actions as ordinary work so nobody notices.
analogy: Puts on a janitor’s uniform — nobody pays attention to a janitor.

solutionNotes.edr: Recognizes disguises by behavior: what a program does, not what it’s called.
solutionNotes.siem: Keeps logs separately — wiping traces on the server is no longer enough.
solutionNotes.email: Opens up archives, documents and attachments where malicious code is hidden.
solutionNotes.dfir: Reconstructs the picture of the attack even after the traces were wiped.
solutionNotes.cnapp: Sees resources in every cloud region, even unused ones.
